attributions.changes: Its words of two to nine letters were kept, written in capitals, as every word a player may try in English.

attributions.author: Kevin Atkinson
attributions.changes: Its three smallest sizes give the words a hidden word is drawn from in English: the ones of five to eight letters, in lowercase and found in ENABLE, never an inflected form, minus its own lists of slurs and profanity and a few more a reading judged unfit. The size a word comes from says how hard it is.
